item_short_desc: Rothco’s Expandable Rubber Grip Baton is an essential tool for law enforcement professionals. This durable baton expands from a compact size to a full 21 inches, providing superior reach when needed. The baton features a carbon steel expanding shaft, ensuring strength and durability during use. Its non-slip TPE rubber handle offers a secure, comfortable grip even in high-pressure situations, allowing for maximum control and precision. Designed with professional needs in mind, this baton is easy to carry and deploy.
